  • Time (t) = 10 seconds

C. Concept:

  • Newton's Second Law for Rotational Motion: This law states that the net torque acting on an object is equal to the product of its moment of inertia and its angular acceleration (τ = Iα).

The angular displacement of the wheel in 10 seconds is 750 radians. Option 1

text_solutions.text:
"Explanation: Before entering the TCA (tricarboxylic acid) cycle, pyruvic acid is converted into acetyl-CoA through a process called oxidative decarboxylation.
  • Oxidative decarboxylation is the correct term for the conversion of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA. In this process:
    • Pyruvate is oxidized (loses electrons) by NAD+ to form NADH.
    • One molecule of carbon dioxide (CO2) is removed (decarboxylation).

This process occurs in the mitochondrial matrix and is catalyzed by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex.
Final Answer : (3)"
